definitions.explanation: A line or crease on skin caused by aging, or a crease in fabric or paper.

examples.english: There are wrinkles on the face.

examples.japanese: ⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皺|しわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦アイロン→アイロン：05071_airon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧。
examples.english: I iron out the wrinkles in my shirt.
Wrinkles appear on the face as you age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目尻|めじり}→目尻：21905_mejiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皺|しわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm concerned about the wrinkles at the corners of my eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーツケース→スーツケース：01781_suutsukeesu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れていた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{皺|しわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ついて→つく：01960_tsuku⟧⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦アイロン→アイロン：05071_airon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: The clothes I had put in my suitcase got wrinkled, so I ironed them.

notes:
{皺|しわ} refers to wrinkles on skin (from aging or expression) and creases in fabric or paper. Often written in hiragana (しわ) in casual contexts.

SKIN WRINKLE COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皺|しわ}: facial wrinkles
- ⟦{目尻|めじり}→目尻：21905_mejiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皺|しわ}: crow's feet
- ⟦{眉間|みけん}→眉間：08540_miken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皺|しわ}: wrinkles between the eyebrows (from frowning)
- ⟦{笑|え}い{皺|じわ}→笑い皺：noentry⟧: laugh lines
- {皺|しわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧: wrinkles appear/form

FABRIC CREASE COLLOCATIONS:
- {皺|しわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: to smooth out wrinkles/creases
- ⟦アイロン→アイロン：05071_airon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{皺|しわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to iron out wrinkles

IDIOM:
⟦{皺寄|しわよ}せ→皺寄せ：28789_shiwayose⟧ means 'passing the burden onto someone else' — the negative consequences are 'pushed' like wrinkles being gathered to one spot.
